Based on the provided image of the process flow diagram web app:

(1) **Yes.** The flowsheet is drawn inside one single, large bordered rectangle (the "sheet") that contains all three zones.
(2) **Yes.** The dashed zone dividers and the labels ("1 - FEED & REFORMING", "2 - SHIFT & PURIFICATION", "3 - SYNTHESIS LOOP & COMPRESSION") are clearly visible and readable in a light grey color against the dark charcoal background.
(3) **Yes.** The title block in the bottom-right corner (labeled "AMMONIA SYNTHESIS PROCESS FLOW DIAGRAM") is fully readable with good contrast.
(4) **Yes.** The recycle loop at the bottom is drawn as one continuous line that runs along the bottom edge of the sheet, connecting the circulator back to the loop mixer.
(5) **No.** There are no significant contrast or readability problems, no overlapping elements, and no clipped elements. The design uses high-contrast white and light-grey lines and text on a dark background to ensure clarity.
